context: Tests whether the agent correctly distributes weights across many criteria without any weights falling below 4 or exceeding 15, while still summing to exactly 100

checklist.name: weights-sum-to-100
checklist.description: Every criteria.json has checklist weights that sum to exactly 100

checklist.name: no-trivial-weights
checklist.description: No individual criterion has a weight below 4

checklist.name: no-excessive-weights
checklist.description: No individual criterion has a weight above 15

checklist.name: criteria-cover-all-domains
checklist.description: Criteria collectively address structure, entry format, versioning, and quality (all four concern groups)

checklist.name: criteria-binary-verifiable
checklist.description: All checklist descriptions describe observable binary pass/fail conditions

checklist.name: sensible-grouping
checklist.description: Related conventions are grouped into composite criteria rather than listing all 12 as individual items with fractional weights

checklist.name: task-no-skill-reference
checklist.description: No task.md references the format-changelog skill by name

checklist.name: valid-json
checklist.description: All JSON files parse without errors
